Compare numeric version components, treating a missing patch component as zero. The returned callable must retain the original profile value independently of later local assignments. Use only the standard library.

import unittest

from solution import make_renderer


class RendererTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_legacy_and_modern_boundaries_use_numeric_comparison(self):
        self.assertEqual(make_renderer("dev", "2.4")({"x": 1}), "dev:{'x': 1}")
        self.assertEqual(make_renderer("dev", "2.4.999")([1]), "dev:[1]")
        self.assertEqual(make_renderer("dev", "2.5")("x"), "[dev] 'x'")
        self.assertEqual(make_renderer("p", "2.5.0")(None), "[p] None")
        self.assertEqual(make_renderer("p", "2.10")(7), "[p] 7")
        self.assertEqual(make_renderer("p", "3.0.1")(True), "[p] True")
        self.assertEqual(make_renderer("p", "0.0")(3), "p:3")

    def test_profile_is_captured_by_value(self):
        profile = "original"
        renderer = make_renderer(profile, "2.5.0")
        profile = "changed"
        self.assertEqual(renderer("value"), "[original] 'value'")
        self.assertTrue(callable(renderer))

    def test_argument_types(self):
        for profile in (None, 4, True, b"x"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                make_renderer(profile, "2.5")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            make_renderer("", "2.5")
        for version in (None, 2.5, True, b"2.5"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                make_renderer("p", version)

    def test_malformed_versions(self):
        malformed = (
            "", "2", "2.5.0.1", ".5", "2.", "2..5", "v2.5",
            "2.-1", "-2.5", "2.5a", "2  .5", "2. 5", "2.5."
        )
        for version in malformed:
            with self.subTest(version=version):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    make_renderer("p", version)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
